statement.canonical: The repository's 5 August casualty record derived from Vitaliy Klitschko Telegram post 7134 is date-misaligned: the exact statement that nine of fifteen injured people remained hospitalized belongs to the 19 July 2026 Kyiv attack chronology, not the overnight 4/5 August attack.

assessment.rationale: The canonical Telegram context exposes post 7134 with the exact wording, while Kyiv's official portal timestamps that same wording at 09:26 local time on 19 July 2026. Independent same-day reporting also dates the statement to 19 July. The affected source-item and observation records remain outside this task's immutable output scope and require a dedicated correction task.
